label: 가을 숲 별빛 캠핑
prompt: Use case illustration-story. One beautiful widescreen 16:9 full bleed presentation background for children, 1536x864. Cozy autumn camping beneath a deep teal twilight sky, richly hand-painted gouache and watercolor storybook art. Copper and amber maple branches hug upper corners. Small glowing cream tent at lower left with lantern, little sleeping fox curled beside it. Quiet lake and distant pine silhouettes along lowest 15%; little mushrooms and leaves at bottom right. Most of image is a huge smooth deep blue-teal evening sky, gently textured, no detailed objects through middle. Tiny stars ONLY at upper outer edges, one small moon far upper right. Keep x22–78%,y20–72% dark and uncluttered for WHITE text and photos. Luminous warm gold light contrasting teal darkness, sophisticated atmospheric depth, reassuring peaceful mood, meticulous details. No words, letters, logos, numbers, watermark, UI, chart, collage or sample text. No campfire or danger, opaque.
inspection: 직접 관찰: 가운데 어두운 청록색 밤하늘 여백, 흰 글씨 권장. 글자·워터마크 없음.
